It's nice not being alone.|Omega, to Emerie Karr|{{TBB|Confined}}}} '''Emerie Karr''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Cloning|clone]] created from the [[Clone template|genetic template]] of the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]]. At some point, Karr was transported off the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] as she was needed elsewhere. Eventually, [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]] took her under his wing. He brought her to [[Mount Tantiss]], where she worked as a [[scientist]] and doctor. In Tantiss, Karr assisted Hemlock and Dr. [[Scalder]] in the daily operations of the facility. Following [[Lieutenant]] [[Nolan]]'s [[death]] at the hands of [[Crosshair]], Karr supervised the clone's medical treatment. When the enhanced female clone [[Omega]] was captured and brought to Mount Tantiss by Hemlock, Karr informed her that Crosshair was still alive and recuperating along with the other rogue clones. Omega was distrustful towards her until Karr revealed that she was her sister. Omega began working with Karr for multiple weeks. During this time, everything became routine for Karr, who took Omega's blood sample daily and instructed Omega to carry a tray of samples, including her own, for testing by [[Nala Se]]. Eventually, Hemlock informed Karr that an unscheduled guest was reported to be arriving at Tantiss. Karr and Omega learned it was [[Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. Omega used the opportunity to escape Tantiss along with Crosshair, despite Karr's warnings of the dangers in the forests surrounding [[Tantiss Base]]. Meanwhile, Karr reported to Hemlock that Omega's blood had a favorable [[Midi-chlorian|M-Count]] replication when combined with the specimen in the [[Tantiss vault|vault]]. In response, Hemlock ordered his troops to stand down, allowing Crosshair and Omega to jump into [[hyperspace]]. Soon after Crosshair and Omega's escape, Karr replaced [[Nala Se]] as the [[Chief Scientist]] on Tantiss. In her new role, Hemlock brought her to the vault. There, Karr discovered her job was to work with a few "specimens" whom she discovered to be [[Force-sensitive]] children, much to her disgust. Hemlock instructed her to only refer to the specimens by their numbers. Karr spoke to Nala Se who informed her that she was now powerless, and it was up to Karr to protect the children and Omega. Karr went to [[Coruscant]] alongside [[Clone Commander]] [[Scorch]] to acquire the most recently apprehended [[Bayrn|child]]. After Hemlock's forces recaptured Omega, Karr reconfirmed her M-Count was favorable with the specimens. In the vault, [[Eva|one of the children]] held a [[straw tooka]] and told Omega that Karr was the only nice one in the facility. After [[Clone Force 99|the Bad Batch]] [[Skirmish on Wayland|infiltrated]] [[Wayland]], Karr went to the [[central lab]]. She discovered [[Echo]] had snuck into the base disguised as a [[TK stormtrooper]] and determined it had to be him after noticing his stolen [[droid]] [[Limb|hand]]. Echo asked her how she could go along with Hemlock's experiments and Karr told him she was just doing her job. Karr told Echo she could get him into the vault, but he had to trust her. They entered the vault only to discover that Omega and the other children had escaped. Hemlock ordered Karr to find Omega as their fates were then linked together. Karr and Echo caught up to the children at the transport [[hangar]]. Echo instructed Karr to bring them to rendezvous coordinates and he'd meet her there after he rescued Omega and the rest of the Bad Batch. Karr followed Echo's instructions and flew the [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|shuttle]] to the planet of [[Pabu]]. After the escape from Tantiss, Karr spoke with Echo on the island of [[Pabu island|Pabu]], where Echo invited her to accompany him to [[Pantora]], as [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]] was interested in hearing about Karr's experiences. Eager to make up for her past misdeeds, she joined the ranks of the [[Clone Underground]] and departed Pabu with Echo on the ''[[Remora]]''. ==Biography== ===Early life=== {{Quote|If you're a clone like me, how come I never saw you on Kamino?''"
"''Because I was sent elsewhere until Dr. Hemlock took me under his wing.|Omega and Karr discussing Karr's past|}} Emerie Karr was created as a [[Cloning|clone]] from the [[Clone template|genetic template]] of [[Jango Fett]], although she was [[Gender|female]] unlike most of the clones. Created by the [[Kaminoan]]s, Karr lived on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] and was aware of another female clone, [[Omega]], who was her sister. At some point, Karr left Kamino and was taken in by [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]]. She came to work at the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Tantiss Base|facilities]] at [[Mount Tantiss]] on the planet [[Wayland]]. ===Imperial scientist=== ====Zillo Beast incident==== {{Quote|We lost communication with transport 904.''"
"''Have the recovery teams begin a search. We need that asset contained.|Karr and Hemlock discussed the missing transport and zillo beast|}} [[File:Emerie_Karr_and_Scorch-_TBB_Metamorphosis.png|thumb|left|275px|Emerie Karr and Scorch report to Dr. Hemlock]] When a [[Transport 904|transport]] carrying a [[Specimen A|Zillo Beast clone]] lost communication with Tantiss Base near the planet [[Silla]], Karr approached Hemlock, who was talking with an imprisoned [[Nala Se]]. She informed Hemlock about the missing transport, and Hemlock ordered for recovery teams to begin a search, and for the transported asset, which was a cloned Zillo Beast, to be contained. Hemlock then asked Karr if there had been Kaminoans who were taken off world prior to the [[Attack on Kamino|destruction of Tipoca City]], and Karr informed him of one: the former Kaminoan [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]]. Hemlock requested that Su be brought before him. Later, Karr informed Hemlock that the [[Zillo Beast]] had been recovered and was secured at Mount Tantiss. She also informed him that Lama Su's [[Rho-class transport shuttle|shuttle]] was arriving as the spoke. ====Assisting Crosshair==== {{Quote|Remain calm. Cooperate, and you might survive.|Emerie Karr, to Crosshair|}} [[File:Emerie_Karr_with_Crosshair-TBB_The_Outpost.png|thumb|right|300px|Emerie Karr told Crosshair to remain calm just after he woke up on Tantiss.]] When the Imperial agent [[Crosshair]] betrayed the Empire, he was taken prisoner and transported to Tantiss Base before being placed under Karr's care. When Crosshair woke up, Karr gently greeted him, telling him that Hemlock would come for him soon. In the meantime, she told him to remain calm and injected him with a chemical that returned him to unconsciousness, adding that if he cooperated, he would have a chance to survive.{{TBB|The Outpost}} [[File:EmerieCrosshairHemlock-TP.png|thumb|left|300px|Emerie listened as Dr. Hemlock tried to convince Crosshair to divulge the whereabouts of Clone Force 99.]] Later, Karr waited for Crosshair in a [[Ray shield|ray-shielded]] cell. When two [[TK stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] escorted him inside, Karr asked Crosshair how he was feeling, but the clone did not answer her question. Hemlock arrived shortly after, remarking that Crosshair had recovered remarkably fast. Hemlock made Crosshair an offer to free him in exchange for revealing the location of [[Clone Force 99]], adding that they had something that belonged to him. Karr witnessed Crosshair deny the notion that he knew where his former squad members were. In response, Crosshair was restrained on the operating table and an [[IT-O interrogation droid|IT-O Interrogation Unit]] entered. While the [[interrogation droid]] began injecting Crosshair, [[Scalder]] informed Hemlock that one of their transport ships had been attacked while departing the planet [[Balmorra]], and that the prisoners aboard it had escaped. Hemlock left Karr to supervise the interrogation and told her to inform him when Crosshair was ready to talk.{{TBB|Tipping Point}} ====Crosshair's failed escape==== {{Quote|You cannot make it out of this facility. Not in your current condition.|Karr warning Crosshair when the clone tried to escape Tantiss|}} [[File:NotInYourCondition-TP.png|thumb|right|300px|Emerie showed concern as she told Crosshair he was in no condition to escape.]] As the interrogation [[droid]] continued, Karr ordered it to stop. A stormtrooper questioned her motives, to which she replied that he could not talk if he was dead. She injected Crosshair with a shot in the arm and then ordered the guards to secure Crosshair's restraints while she retrieved a [[datapad]] and checked his vitals. However, Crosshair grabbed one of the trooper's [[DC-15A blaster carbine|blaster]] and shot them as well as the interrogation droid. While being held at blaster-point, Karr attempted to reason with Crosshair, but the imprisoned clone forced her to remove his restraints. She warned him that he would not be able to escape the facility in his weakened condition and the [[Lurca hound|hounds]] would find him in minutes. She requested him to not make the situation worse, telling him there was no escape, but he nevertheless [[stun]]ned her with the blaster. Shortly afterward, Crosshair was recaptured and returned to the cell. Once again fastened to the table, Karr followed Hemlock inside to once again interrogate him. This time, Karr only watched as the droid injected him again, this time with a higher injection level, per Hemlock's orders. ====Meeting Omega==== {{Quote|I want to talk to Nala Se''"
"''Ironic. You trust the Kaminoan, but not me.'' "
"''I don't know you.''"
"''No? You might know me better than you think. We're sisters, Omega.|Omega and Karr|}} [[File:EmerieKarrRevelation-Plan99.png|thumb|left|300px|Emerie revealed to Omega that they were sisters.]] When Imperial forces captured Omega on [[Ord Mantell]], the young clone was brought to Tantiss Base. Karr met Omega there and watched as Omega tried to help Crosshair, whom she had found unconscious and strapped to a table in a large room of other clone prisoners. Omega demanded to know what they had done to him, and Karr calmly responded that he was recovering and that she had tried to warn him what would happen if he did not cooperate with Hemlock. Omega demanded to speak with Nala Se, and Karr replied that it was ironic that Omega did not trust her, then revealed to Omega that they were sisters, which shocked Omega. ====Working with Omega==== [[File:Emerie_speaks_with_Omega-TBB_Confined.png|thumb|right|300px|Emerie greats Omega and tells her she was not a prisoner and will acclimate.]] One morning shortly after Omega became imprisoned on Tantiss, Karr greeted Omega in her [[Omega's room|room]]. Omega insisted she was being held as a prisoner, but Karr rebutted Omega's claim, telling her she would acclimate. Karr then led Omega through the corridors, passing several imprisoned [[clone trooper]]s, including Crosshair; who were guarded by [[clone commando]]s. Karr led Omega to the laboratory, where they collected blood samples from the imprisoned clones. As they finished, Karr told Omega that lastly, she would need to collect a sample from her. Omega reluctantly obliged. As Karr took Omega's sample, Omega asked her why she had not seen Karr on Kamino. Karr replied she had been sent elsewhere until Hemlock took her under his wing. She explained that Hemlock saw potential in her, just like Nala Se saw potential in Omega. Omega noted it would have been nice if she had a sister around. Karr then instructed Omega to send the tray of blood samples to Nala Se. Unbeknownst to Karr, Nala Se discarded Omega's sample upon receiving the tray of blood samples. Omega also secretly visited Crosshair's cell and tried to convince him unsuccessfully to trust Karr. The next day Karr and Omega went through the same procedure. However, this time, Omega was subject to a surprise cell inspection by clone commandos. They found and confiscated the [[straw tooka]] Omega had made, handing it to Karr. Karr reminded Omega that personal items were forbidden. After that incident, everything else quickly became routine between Karr and Omega. Immediately after Omega released a lurca [[Dog|hound]] whom she named [[Batcher]], she was cornered by Hemlock and Karr. Hemlock scolded Omega for releasing the wounded animal, insisting that Batcher’s domestication only made her vulnerable to the deadly wild beasts roaming the planet. Omega countered saying Batcher deserves a chance to live. While Omega continued to protest, Karr attempted to defuse the situation by volunteering to return Omega to her cell. However, Hemlock rejected her and continued to press Omega, threatening to hurt Crosshair if she did not cooperate. As Omega backed down, Hemlock instructed Karr to escort Omega back to her cell and restrict her access. Karr later went to speak with Omega in her room. Omega told Karr to leave. However when Omega turned her head to the doorway, she discovered Karr had given her back the straw tooka. ====The Emperor’s arrival==== Around 164 days after Omega arrived on Wayland, [[Darth Sidious|Emperor Palpatine]] traveled to the facility. As the facility became a buzz of activity, Karr told Omega that she did not know what was happening and told her it was best not to ask questions. As Karr prepared for their daily samples, Hemlock and Nala Se entered, and Hemlock told Karr about Palpatine's imminent presence and said that it required his and Nala Se’s attention. Hemlock instructed Karr to finish the blood testing in the lab herself instead of handing it off to Nala Se. Nala Se objected to this, wanting to do it herself so she could secretly discard Omega's sample, but Hemlock dismissed her. After finishing the samples, Karr went to the [[central lab]], with Omega trailing her. As Karr prepared the [[centrifuge]], she noticed Omega acting strange. Karr was unaware that Nala Se had instructed Omega to escape the facility, telling her that she would be in great danger if her sample was tested. Karr asked if Omega was doing alright, but before waiting for her answer, decided to dismiss her and gently told her to forget the rest of her duties for the day and to return to her room until she felt better. Unbeknownst to Karr, Omega stole Nala Se's datapad, as she had been instructed to, before leaving the lab.{{TBB|Shadows of Tantiss}} Later, Karr went to check on Omega at her cell, only to discover it empty. Remembering Omega's incident with the lurca hounds, she quickly went to check the hound kennels, where she found Omega and Crosshair trying to escape, the former having freed the latter from his cell. As Crosshair raised a blaster at her, Karr calmly offered to quietly return them to their cells, promising she would tell no one of their deception. Omega countered, telling Karr that she lived confined on Kamino her entire life and Tantiss was now a second form of captivity for her. Omega reminded Karr she was a clone too and asked Karr to help them. Although this caused Karr to momentarily pause, she nonetheless alerted her superiors, leading to Crosshair stunning her. As a result, Crosshair and Omega escaped through [[Batcher]]'s [[Lurca kennels|kennel]]. ====Omega and Crosshair’s escape==== Hemlock and the clone commandos found Karr unconscious on the ground by the kennels and helped her back to her [[Limb|feet]]. Karr informed them Omega had a datapad and had used it to escape with Crosshair through the kennels. Hemlock subsequently ordered the other Lurca hounds be released to help track down the fugitives. Karr objected, citing the hounds could kill Omega and Crosshair. Hemlock replied they were now escapees and needed to be stopped at all costs. Karr returned to the lab to examine the remaining blood samples as ''Rho''-class shuttles were filled with [[stormtrooper]]s and were sent to track down Omega and Crosshair. Shortly after the escapees hijacked one of the [[shuttle]]s, Karr scanned Omega’s sample. While [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|V-wings]] pursued the stolen [[Starship|ship]], Karr discovered Omega’s blood sample supported a positive [[Midi-chlorian|M-count]] transfer. She informed Hemlock, who in turn ordered the V-wings to stand down, as they needed Omega alive to finish their experiments. Karr’s timely report meant that Crosshair and Omega were allowed to escape into [[hyperspace]]. Moments later, Hemlock told Karr and the rest of his staff that the clones’ escape was a minor setback, and that he would use all of the Empire’s resources to track them down. ===Karr's promotion=== ====The truth about Tantiss==== [[File:IdentityCrisisTBB-Thumbnail.png|thumb|left|275px|Emerie enters the Tantiss vault]] After Hemlock left the [[Tantiss vault]] to speak with Karr and [[Scorch]], Karr reported that progress in the laboratory had stalled since Nala Se’s detainment. Hemlock replied that Nala Se could not be trusted following her role in Omega and Crosshair's escape. Karr asked him if he trusted her, since she had worked by his side for years and said that she could be of more help if given the right clearance. Hemlock asked if Karr desired to be promoted to [[Chief Scientist]] and then reluctantly agreed. He told Karr to follow him and proceeded to update her about [[Project Necromancer]].{{TBB|Identity Crisis}} Hemlock led Karr through a corridor leading to the Vault, which was guarded by clone commandos. As they passed through the series of scanners, they passed several more clone commandos and other security.{{Databank|tantiss-vault|Tantiss vault}} Simultaneously, Hemlock explained to Karr there were specimens inside that were vital to Project Necromancer’s success, and they must be handled with the greatest care. Inside a windowless circular chamber, in the heart of Mount Tantiss, Karr met three [[Force-sensitive]] [[alien]] younglings, all with a high M-count; an [[Iktotchi]] designated [[Eva|SP-54]], a [[Mirialan]] designated [[Jax (Mirialan)|SP-32]], and a [[Sami (Pantoran)|Pantoran female]]. Karr asked why they were experimenting on children, rather than adults. Hemlock replied there were few Force-sensitive adults left and that children were easier to control. These children were kept imprisoned in the vault and under constant observation, as they were essential to Emperor Palpatine’s plans. Karr and Hemlock followed Scalder, who escorted the Iktotchi into a room where a [[Imperial nanny droid|nanny droid]] extracted a blood sample from her. Hemlock explained to Karr that M-counts could not be directly replicated from the source, but that Nala Se knew of an alternate method. Omega had been the only binder proven to be compatible with their DNA to replicate their M-count levels, and Nala Se had helped her escape once she had discovered this. Therefore, it was imperative that Omega was found, and they must be prepared for the scenario she was retrieved. Moments later, Hemlock talked with Scorch, while Karr spoke with the Iktotchi child. She smiled at Karr and told her that her [[Goggles|glasses]] were nice. When Karr asked what her name was, Hemlock interjected, ordering her to limit her interactions with the specimens. ====Jax's escape attempt==== As Karr oversaw the nanny droid collecting blood samples from the SP-54, the girl greeted her. Karr addressed her as SP-54, but the girl introduced herself as Eva, proceeding to ask for Karr's name. Karr told Eva she could refer to her as "Dr. Karr." Eva asked Karr what happened to Nala Se and why she was no longer overseeing the project. Karr told Eva that was none of her concern. Eva said that Nala Se promised that she would find out when she would be going home and asked Karr to find out for her, to which Karr replied she would look into it. Karr then attended to SP-32. While Karr was busy working on her datapad, SP-32 dodged the nanny droid, grabbing an unsuspecting Karr’s datapad, and charged out of the lab. Scalder, who was in the vault's upper tier, placed the vault into complete lockdown, while Karr and two nanny droids attempted to stop him, to no avail. He yelled that he wanted to go home, just like Eva. The boy successfully slid Karr's datapad into the wall panel but was upset that the door would not unlock. He was cornered by Karr and the droids. Karr told him it was alright, and he was safe. He told Karr that was not his name and like Eva, he said he wanted to go home. Moments later, Scorch and two clone commandos entered the vault, with the commander ordering his subordinates to set their [[weapon]]s for stun. Karr insisted [[blaster]]s were not necessary and she had everything under control. However, Scorch stunned Jax anyway, much to Karr’s resentment. Scorch ordered Jax to be secured in his room. Karr retorted his actions were extreme, as Jax was just a child. Later, while the medical droids extracted the required blood sample from SP-32, Eva asked if Jax would be okay. After Eva confirmed Jax was SP-32, Karr reassured Eva that he would be fine. Karr insisted Jax was not in trouble, and he could be visited the next day. ====Responsibility==== Later on, Karr visited Nala Se in her cell to seek answers about the experiments in the Tantiss vault. Nala Se realized Karr has replaced her in her former position, and she had seen the vault. Karr worriedly told Se the specimen were children, like she was. She then asked Nala Se if her plan was to discard the children. Se reconfirmed the Galactic Empire planned to kept the children so they could be controlled. Karr replied that the children did not belong on Tantiss, to which the Kaminoan agreed. Nala Se told Karr she had done all she could to protect Omega, as well as the other children, and it was now Karr’s responsibility to protect them. Karr said she had no power to do anything, but Nala Se told her to reconsider. After Karr left Nala Se’s cell, she was encountered by Hemlock and Scorch in the corridor. Hemlock told her he knew of Jax’s escape and informed her another, far younger specimen was ready for pick up. Karr requested to go herself, to ensure the specimen was “handled carefully.” Hemlock originally declined her request, but then agreed and allowed her to go alongside Scorch. Karr, Scorch, and a squad of TK stormtroopers traveled to [[Imperial Station 003]] located above [[Coruscant]] to rendezvous with the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]]. Bane remarked Karr was not the Imperial he normally dealt with, and Karr replied she was there to examine the specimen and not to answer any other questions. Bane's droid, [[Todo 360]], brought out a [[Bayrn|feline child]] in a floating cradle. Karr turned to Scorch and commented the specimen was far younger than expected, but Scorch was unconcerned, replying that would make him easier to handle. While Karr verified the child's M-count, a stormtrooper paid Bane. Karr then asked Bane how many Force-sensitive children he had brought in, and Bane responded that was confidential, only confirming he was good at his job. [[File:Emerie_Karr_holding_a_straw_Tooka-TBB_Identity_Crisis.png|thumb|right|275px|Emerie pulled the straw tooka out of a drawer and gave it to Eva.]] When Karr returned to the Tantiss vault, she was informed that Jax had been placed in solitary confinement for two days. An angry Eva said Karr lied about Jax not being punished, reiterating they all wanted to go home. Later, while Karr compared the children’s blood samples with Omega’s in the central lab, she pulled the box with Omega’s straw tooka out of a drawer. As a consolation, Karr gave the [[tooka doll]] to Eva and watched her take it into her possession from the vault’s upper tier. ===Omega’s return=== Immediately after Omega was returned to Tantiss, Hemlock escorted her down a turbolift, bringing her back to Nala Se's lab and Karr’s care. Omega and Karr stared at each other in shock for a moment. Hemlock then ordered Karr to use Omega's blood to confirm the experiment still succeeded. When Omega asked Hemlock what happened to Nala Se, Hemlock replied the Kaminoan had been imprisoned and would not aid Omega in any further escape efforts. Hemlock told Karr he would return later to check on results before departing. Omega told Karr that she did not have to go through with the experiment, but Karr reluctantly said that she had no choice. As she extracted a sample from Omega, Karr remarked she was glad her sister was safe. Omega asked if she was truly safe, but Karr did not respond.{{TBB|Juggernaut (episode)}} As Karr finished analyzing Omega's blood sample, she reconfirmed Omega's blood produced a favorable M-Count replication when combined with the specimen in the vault. Hemlock was not surprised and expected the outcome. He then escorted Omega into the Tantiss Vault and explained why she was quintessential to their cloning efforts. After Omega was imprisoned in the vault, she spoke with a fellow prisoner, Eva, while the sat at one of the tables, noticing the straw tooka Eva was holding. Eva told Omega that Karr had given it to her and that she was the only nice person who worked in the facility.{{TBB|Into the Breach}} Later, while Karr extracted Omega’s sample, Omega asked her where the other children came from. Karr told Omega that she had no idea and the only thing she knew for sure was they were well looked after. Omega told Karr that she would like to believe her while a [[Tantiss medical droid]] collected a test tube containing her sample and deposited it in a dumbwaiter system located in the wall. While Karr was distracted, Omega stole a small metal tool and hid it in her sleeve. Soon after, as Omega spoke with the other children in the vault’s common area, Karr talked with Dr. Scalder, who objected to Omega mingling with the other children. Karr countered and said that the children were engaged in activities designed to keep their minds active and reassured her colleague that they had them under constant observation. Scalder remarked that their protocols had not stopped Omega from escaping before. Karr reconfirmed her authority, reminding Scalder that she was the Chief Scientist and said that she would run the vault as she saw fit. ===The Bad Batch arrive at Tantiss=== When the Batch arrived at Tantiss, they were quickly intercepted by V-wings and [[turbolaser]] [[Laser cannon|cannons]] as they made their approach. In the vault's observation deck, Karr and her colleagues learned about the intrusion. She ordered to implement lockdown procedures in the vault and tasked Scalder with safeguarding the children. Scalder retorted and told her that her concern for the "specimens" was unwarranted.{{TBB|Flash Strike}} Later, Karr entered the lab shortly after [[Echo]], who had smuggled himself on a [[science vessel]] and disguised himself as a TK trooper, entering Nala Se's lab. He gained access to a computer with information about Omega's Midi-chlorian count, when Karr entered the lab, confronting him. She inspected the trooper, as he discreetly placed the droid hand he stole from a [[RA-7-81|protocol droid]] back on top of his [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] [[scomp link]]. She told him troopers were not permitted in the lab. Echo claimed it was a special security protocol, but Karr noticed his droid hand. As he left the lab, Karr addressed him as Echo and informed him Omega told her about her squad and that they would eventually come for her. Echo said the Bad Batch were not just there to rescue Omega, but to also liberate all other prisoners being experimented in Tantiss. Karr said she was just following orders and Echo replied he'd heard that before. Removing his helmet to look her in the [[eye]], he asked her how she could participate in Hemlock's projects as she was a fellow clone. Echo said Omega vouched for Karr and he hoped she was right and demanded to know her location. Karr informed Echo that Omega was inside the vault and he had to trust her in order to get him inside and free the children. Karr explained to a surprised Echo that Omega was not the only child imprisoned in the base. ===Escaping Tantiss=== Karr warned Echo the longer the facility remained on lockdown, the greater the danger of him being discovered. However, Echo was more concerned about why he could not find any records of the vault. Karr explained the databanks were heavily encrypted, the vault was several levels below them and Hemlock kept it under heavy guard, but she could get Echo inside. Echo was hesitant and asked the scientist why she was helping him. Karr told Echo that she had realized her past actions were wrong, and she was ready to make amends and do the right thing. [[File:Emerie_and_Echo-_TBB_The_Cavalry_Has_Arrived.png|thumb|left|275px|Emerie Karr speaking with Echo as they prepared to enter the Tantiss vault.]] As they entered the vault, she told Echo the children were kidnapped by bounty hunters from different undisclosed locations, and their genetic material was required for certain medical testing. She informed Echo she did not know of the children until shortly before and she was unable to help them until the present moment. When Echo asked how Omega fit into the testing, Karr replied she was vital to Project Necromancer. Inside, they found Hemlock and Scorch. Hemlock told them Omega and the other children incapacitated Scalder and fled using a weak point in the walls. Soon after, the room violently trembled before Scorch reported that the Zillo Beast had broken from containment. As Hemlock left to contain the situation, he instructed Karr find Omega and return her to the vault and their fates were now tied to each other. After Hemlock and Scorch left, Echo told Karr that Omega released the Zillo Beast to create a diversion as it was exactly what he would have done. Karr and Echo made their way to the doors to the [[sublevel containment chamber]], only to discover a trail of carnage inside, which led Echo to conclude that the children used the ladders to climb up to the surface. They opted to take a shortcut to a transport hangar at the top of the shaft. On their way up, they came across the [[CX squad]], who had just captured the rest of Clone Force 99, agreeing to come back and help them after ensuring the children's safety. Shortly afterward, they intercepted two TK stormtroopers, just as they prepared to report the children's position. Echo stunned the troopers, before he revealed his identity to the children. A surprised Eva asked Karr if she was helping them. The scientist confirmed she was helping them escape but warned they had to hurry. Karr and Echo then escorted the children to the hangar. Upon reaching a [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class shuttle]], Echo informed Omega the rest of Clone Force 99 was captured. Echo gave Karr coordinates and told her to take the other children there, and he and Omega would rendezvous with them after they freed the rest of the clones. When the other children embraced Omega, she confirmed to them that Karr was bringing them to a safe location. Before Karr left, she gave Omega her datapad, instructing her to use it to access all wings of Tantiss Base. As Echo and Omega headed back inside the base, Karr led the other children onto the shuttle and departed from Tantiss, soon arriving on [[Pabu]]. [[File:TBB-EchoEmeriePabu.png|thumb|right|300px|Emerie Karr agreed to accompany Echo as part of the Clone Underground.]] Soon after, on the island of [[Pabu island|Pabu]], Karr spoke with Echo. He invited Karr to accompany him to [[Pantora]], as [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]] was interested in hearing about her experiences. Eager to make up for her past misdeeds, Karr joined the ranks of the [[Clone Underground]]. The two clones left Pabu on the ''[[Remora]]''. ==Personality and traits== [[File:EmerieKarr-YIR2024.png|left|thumb|250x250px|Emerie Karr during her days as an Imperial scientist]] Emerie Karr was a [[human]] female with long [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], which she kept in a simple ponytail, brown eyes and tan skin. Karr was calm and emotionless during most of her work, so her motivations and actions were at times challenging to read. She was also a diligent and stoic worker, having compassion for the clone prisoners, although she believed that resisting the Empire was futile. Karr helped experiment on the clone troopers; however, she at times experienced feelings of empathy and compassion towards them. She had a soft spot for Omega, whom she considered her sister, and even attempted to help Crosshair during his imprisonment. When Omega and Crosshair attempted to escape, she was reluctant to act in a hostile manner towards them, although she did attempt to capture them. When Omega tried to convince her to come and escape with them, Karr decided against it and warned the Empire of their escape, leading to Crosshair stunning her. After her experiences on Tantiss, culminating in her role in supervising kidnapped children, she found herself unable to serve the Empire any longer; she helped the Bad Batch rescue the imprisoned clones and children before joining the Clone Underground, believing she still had a great deal of work to do if she wanted to make up for her past. ==Equipment== Karr primarily carried a datapad and after Omega was captured and detained at Tantiss Base, she received a small device that measured a person's M-count level. This was done by taking a person's blood sample and putting it in the device. The device scanned the blood sample and if it flashed green, then the person had a high M-count. Karr also wore a pair of goggles. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:KeishaCastleHughesIMDB.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Emerie Karr was voiced by Keisha Castle-Hughes]] {{Quote|I think I learned it, maybe an episode before we recorded the episode where there was the reveal that they were sisters. Which was a huge shift, as well, especially for Emerie Karr. You know, it was like, 'Oh, wow.' I've been playing this character who comes from a really practical place, in a clone-like way, and then to all of a sudden kind of be like, 'Oh, well, she has family here,' which raises the stakes all of a sudden. It was really exciting when I learned about that new storyline.|Keisha Castle-Hughes on learning Emerie Karr was Omega's sister|}} Emerie Karr first appeared in "[[Metamorphosis (episode)|Metamorphosis]]," the eleventh episode in the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' and was voiced by [[Keisha Castle-Hughes]]. Castle-Hughes previously played [[Queen]] [[Apailana]] in the [[2005]] film {{Film|III}}, the third and last installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].{{Film|III}} When Castle-Hughes first was given the role of Emerie Karr, she was told very little about the character. Although she assumed that Karr and Omega would have some connection due to the fact that both she and [[Michelle Ang]], who voiced Omega, were instructed to use their natural New Zealand accents, the show's creators did not tell her that Karr and Omega were sisters until she recorded for the final episode of the second season. ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Metamorphosis (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|The
